study.title: Right to Repair Claims Across Social Media

claims.text: President Trump signed a presidential memo to make it easier for Americans to repair their own cars by protecting the right to fix vehicles and opening up more options for approving aftermarket parts
claims.label: gap
claims.why: Article has no mention of the June 2026 presidential memorandum on vehicle repair or aftermarket parts approval.
claims.author: FoxNews
claims.question: What claims are people making about right to repair?

claims.text: The FTC announced a right-to-repair settlement with John Deere on July 8, 2026
claims.label: gap
claims.why: United States section stops at the 2021 FTC report; nothing on a July 2026 FTC and states settlement with Deere.

claims.text: The settlement provides farmers access to the same software as dealers on a schedule reported every 60 days over a 10-year period
claims.label: gap
claims.why: Settlement terms (dealer-equivalent software access, 60-day reporting, 10 years) are absent; article only describes Deere's 2023 Farm Bureau memorandum.

claims.text: Under the EU's new right to repair rules, manufacturers will have to offer repairs where possible, keep spare parts reasonably priced, and give independent repair shops a fair chance
claims.label: covered
claims.why: EU section already states the directive's repair obligation at reasonable price and application from July 31, 2026.
